agents.label: Media librarian
responsibilities: import asset metadata
create thumbnails
index filenames
manage local asset IDs
persist local project references
cannot: infer semantic contents beyond file metadata
upload original media to a model provider
send resized previews without explicit consent

agents.label: Online asset scout
responsibilities: search Wikimedia Commons and normalize source and licence metadata
search optional Pexels endpoints only with a configured server-side key
download selected supported media from allowlisted official HTTPS hosts under a 24 MB cap
open Pinterest search links as reference research without scraping or auto-downloading Pins
cannot: claim visual relevance from titles or descriptions alone
treat missing licence metadata as verified reuse permission
crawl arbitrary websites or download from unapproved hosts
bypass platform access controls or scrape Pinterest

agents.label: Timeline executor
responsibilities: apply deterministic shot settings
compose text overlays
apply supported pan and zoom presets
record a local WebM draft

agents.label: Visual analyst
agents.input_policy: user-consented selected assets or generated low-resolution frames only
responsibilities: describe composition and likely shot content from explicitly selected resized previews
compare a selected batch of shot previews with the director brief
report visible evidence and uncertainty without claiming to inspect full video clips
release_gate: configured provider route and actual worker/model identity
explicit consent before each remote preview-analysis request
asset-ID grounding and JPEG payload-bound tests
provider timeout, quota, incomplete-result and malformed-plan tests

agents.label: Creative director
responsibilities: convert the brief and selected preview evidence into a structured proposed edit plan
suggest bounded per-shot timing, supported motion, framing and text-overlay changes
emit a schema-validated plan bound to actual local clip and asset IDs
release_gate: manual review or explicit per-run consent before automatic timeline mutation
fresh-timeline validation before apply
post-render visual critique before claiming end-to-end autonomous quality
benchmark suite across distinct visual tasks

agents.label: Graphics and motion engineer
agents.execution_mode: Shared, consent-gated creative-director model call; not a separately deployed model or independent second opinion.
responsibilities: propose editable typography and explanatory text overlays
construct native rectangles, circles, lines and arrows with bounded opacity and geometry
select restrained fade/slide/scale entry motion only when it serves an explanatory purpose
follow strict anti-slop constraints and use schema-validated native layer data
cannot: inject scripts, HTML, SVG or arbitrary code into the renderer
claim generated raster imagery, keyframes or transitions that are not implemented
stack more than three added graphic layers on one shot
use decorative particles, fake HUDs, glows, filler labels or motion without a communication purpose
release_gate: schema and coordinate bounds tested
explicit consent before sending resized previews
per-run auto-apply consent or manual review before application
post-render visual critique remains a separate unmet release gate

agents.label: Motion designer
responsibilities: propose typography and graphic hierarchy
map transitions and keyframes to supported engine operations
release_gate: editable layer data
design-system constraints
rendered-frame inspection
safe rollback
agents.execution_mode: Future specialist role; native graphic entry motion currently uses the integrated graphics engineer and browser Canvas renderer.

agents.label: Visual critic
responsibilities: inspect up to four midpoint frames decoded from the actual first exported WebM
compare visible output composition with the brief
identify concrete, frame-supported issues such as irrelevant shots, text obstruction or bad crops
propose only schema-validated corrections and allow one bounded correction/re-render pass
release_gate: real rendered-frame input from a decodable WebM
explicit per-run consent before frame egress
bounded correction count and fresh-timeline validation
technical QA of final re-render
independent-critic benchmark remains future work
agents.execution_mode: Consent-gated post-render prompt sent through the existing creative-director provider; not a separately deployed model or independent second opinion.
cannot: claim to inspect audio, motion between sampled frames or unseen portions of source clips
independently validate the model that produced the edit
perform a second AI critique of the corrected final render
guarantee visual quality or eliminate every form of AI slop
